title: Using 4D-STEM and TKD as Complementary Techniques for Nanocrystals Orientation Mapping
content: Crystal-orientation mapping of polycrystalline materials reveals useful information, such as crystallographic-preferred orientations, grain-size distribution, and grain-boundary information. These types of information are crucial for understanding the structure-to-property relationships in materials, as well as investigating the material-specific formation and deformation mechanisms.
